title: Altimetría 100Mi Patagonia Run 2026 — official elevation profile PDF
claims: The official one-page PDF is titled 'Altimetría 100Mi Patagonia Run 2026' and gives 160.3 km with D+ 9,221 m.
The profile labels the start at RCM4 as 740 m above sea level and the finish in San Martín de los Andes as 651 m.
The highest labelled summit on the profile is 'Cumbre CE Colorado' at 1,765 m; a later labelled summit, 'Cumbre Quechuquina', is 1,650 m.
The profile does not print a cumulative descent figure; the 2026 100 Millas page separately warns that the circuit is based on the 2026 edition and may change for 2027.
The 2027 100 Millas page also serves the same 2026 profile as a 2,560×623 JPG at /wp-content/uploads/2026/03/Altimetria_100Millas_2026-scaled.jpg, alongside the PDF download link.

verification.checkedVia: curl.exe + local 7890 proxy; downloaded the 721,563-byte PDF and visually read its single page
